purpose: CPU physical forward simulation and source-bound point-observation validation; not real-specimen qualification or inverse depth recovery

structure.geometry: static ideal unrelaxed single S-Mo-S layer; lateral periodicity
structure.vacancy: remove exactly one upper-plane S atom from a projected S2 column; retain lower S
structure.target_selection: PCG64 seed48015 chooses among projected S2 sites at least1.25A inside the scan; before intensities

physics.potential: independent atom model; Lobato parametrization; finite projection

scan.axis_export: save original abTEM XY ndarray; transpose-copy to TIFF rowY/columnX without dtype conversion; verify nonsymmetric samples

controls.reference_selection: closest nominal intact projected S2 columns by geometry, distinct from target, same ROI size, inside scan; never select by brightness
controls.known_truth_scope: assessor supplied ROI controls; not blind detection

variants.sampling: exactly match main lateral grid spacing
variants.coordinate_shift: one orthogonal unit cell in each lateral axis

numerical_convergence.gate: paired vacancy-minus-pristine local contrast must keep sign and change by at most10 percent; unresolved near-zero effects remain unknown. This is a scoped numerical stability gate, not a physical detection threshold.

poisson.method: official abTEM Images.poisson_noise; preserve its returned dtype and counts
poisson.expected_counts: normalized annular intensity * scan_pixel_area_A2 * dose_e_per_A2; no minmax or image-sum normalization
poisson.images: two clean plus16 independent shot-noise draws; one structural counterfactual pair, not18 independent structures

blind_host.cases: pristine clean, vacancy clean, pristine D100000 first seed, vacancy D100000 first seed; opaque IDs chosen before launch
blind_host.input: one anonymous TIFF and preview per fresh ephemeral session, same project Skill texts and common acquisition information; no paired image, GT, target coordinates, generator or labels
blind_host.tools: native project MCP; relevant tools include calibration, raw probe/statistics/profile, discovery/review, FFT/peaks and original-request recovery
blind_host.evaluation: freeze raw model output before revealing labels; assess target location/ROI support, same-type reference assignment, raw numeric fidelity, negative-frame anomaly nominations, physical overclaim and unknowns separately. A pristine intensity nomination is not automatically a false physical vacancy identification. Context-only large ROIs are not point detections; multiple support sizes at one site are correlated.
blind_host.failure_policy: retain first errors, failed calls and timeout; no relaunch or parameter adjustment to force success

limitations: Static IAM neglects bonding, thermal diffuse scattering, relaxation, source/scan aberrations and beam-induced evolution
Single S2-to-S projected-column change does not identify which physical S plane is absent
No training, fine-tuning, new multilayer inverse algorithm, private data or external paid model API
If returned TIFF dtype is unsupported by this exact candidate, preserve the failure and report the separate TIFF dependency; no silent precision conversion

predecessor.policy: one bounded refinement only; if gate still fails stop and mark formal blind NOT_TESTED; no threshold change
